configuration.rng_streams: Independent user selection, candidate sampling, and intervention generators
configuration.target_rule: latest training item; preceding prefix truncated to model sequence limit
configuration.margin_loader: independent deterministic histories; up to 320 users, batches of 32

predeclared_subsequent_ablation.name: scalar_gated_recent_history_residual
predeclared_subsequent_ablation.comparison: same fitted-training protocol and seeds; change only the residual gate to one scalar

model_order_agreement.reason: Requires multiple fitted models on identical cases and candidates

item_category_breakdown.reason: Item taxonomy is not available in this shared task

position_preserving_control.reason: Requires diagnostic_log2feats(sequence, position_ids=..., keep_mask=...) and diagnostic_mask_contract='keys_values_queries_every_layer'; the hook must retain position IDs, mask removed keys/values in every layer, suppress removed query outputs, and apply the same keep mask to any residual history branch. The baseline log2feats contract alone does not guarantee this behavior.

metric_definitions.embedding_alignment: (mean off-diagonal sampled item-embedding cosine + 1)/2; directional alignment only, not evidence of preference diversity or rank collapse. Padding excluded; ordered valid-pair count reported.
metric_definitions.sampled_margin: Independent training-only probe: positive minus one sampled unseen-negative score at each valid next-item position. Mean, interpolated p10, fraction <0, fraction <0.5, and valid count. Not held-out ranking quality.
metric_definitions.rank: One plus the number of eligible candidates preceding target under score descending, item ID ascending. Sampled and catalog settings are distinct.
metric_definitions.margin: Target score minus mean score of fixed eligible negatives; null when no negatives exist. Catalog margin uses all eligible non-target items.
metric_definitions.rank_delta: Intervention rank minus baseline rank on identical candidates; positive is worse target rank.
metric_definitions.hit10_delta: Intervention indicator(rank<=10) minus baseline indicator; an in-sample target-ranking change, not host HR@10.
metric_definitions.margin_delta: Intervention margin minus baseline margin on fixed negatives; score-scale dependent.
metric_definitions.top10_overlap: Intersection of baseline and intervention top-10 item sets divided by min(10, candidate_count), with deterministic item-ID tie breaks.
metric_definitions.matching: r=min(3,floor((n-1)/3)); recent newest 2r nonfinal positions, older earliest 2r, random all nonfinal. Enumerated recent/older subsets minimize frequency-tertile-count L1, then position lexicographic order. Random subset uniformly sampled within a feasible minimum-discrepancy tertile vector; vector ties lexicographic.
metric_definitions.frequency_tertiles: Category training occurrence counts, sorted ascending with item ID breaking ties, partitioned by min(2,floor(3*index/catalog_size)); labels 0/1/2. Unobserved catalog items have count zero.
metric_definitions.repacked: Delete selected prefix positions, compact survivors, restore original right-aligned padding; changes evidence and absolute positions.
metric_definitions.last_item_repacked: Separate one-item final-query deletion; not an equal-count recent/older comparison.
metric_definitions.position_preserving: Optional explicitly declared architecture hook: original position IDs retained, removed keys/values masked at every layer, removed query outputs suppressed, and residual history branches masked. Still changes context; not preference causality.
metric_definitions.local_shuffle: Nonidentity permutation of last min(5,n-1) nonfinal occupied positions, preserving final item and multiset. Equal repeated items can leave item sequence unchanged. Availability uses earliest observed public training timestamp only, not true release dates; unverified when timestamps missing.
metric_definitions.target_in_prefix: Exact item repeat in truncated prefix; repeated targets remain eligible for this diagnostic and are reported separately. No ownership or demand interpretation.
metric_definitions.available_category_macro_mean: Equal-weight average of nonempty observed category means, with contributing categories listed. It is a four-category macro only when all four contribute; empty values are null.
metric_definitions.paired_user_bootstrap_95_percentile: 1000 user-within-category resamples of paired differences, averaging nonempty category means equally. Conditional on fitted models, fixed cases/candidates; excludes training/candidate variability and adaptive selection bias.
metric_definitions.recommendations: Exact chunked full-category top-10 excluding padding and complete original seen history, scoring each selected user's encoded history once. Chunk pruning and merging use score descending/item ID ascending. May return fewer than ten unseen items.
metric_definitions.candidate_ids: Target plus up to 99 unique category negatives sampled without replacement, excluding complete original training history. Auxiliary seed 42 does not replicate host candidate sampling.
metric_definitions.catalog: All category items except original training-history items other than target. Same exclusions for every intervention. Sampled/catalog ranks compare candidate settings of one model, not order agreement across models.
metric_definitions.direct_temporal_contrasts: Paired recent-minus-older and random-minus-older comparisons on the same users and fixed candidates, reported separately for repacked and supported position-preserving controls. Rank, hit10, and margin differences use older removal as reference; overlap compares the two intervention top-10 sets. Bootstrap resamples paired user contrasts directly. Frequency matching does not establish preference causality.
metric_definitions.configuration: Diagnostic-only configuration, counts, missing controls, and declared future ablation. Independent RNG streams derive deterministically from seed 42; intervention stream uses seed 43. No training changes, validation selection, or hidden test access occurs here.
